name: JT Five Oaks Data Centre
notes: Official JT facility product description identifies Five Oaks as a Tier 3 data centre with dual 1.5 MVA transformers, 4x560 kVA generators, 2x800 kVA UPS units, 660 kW cooling, rack colocation, and 24x7 operations. DatacenterMap places it at La Grande Route De St Martin, St Saviour. Bailiwick Express reported in 2014 that JT had invested in the Five Oaks Jersey data centre and that it was one of JT's certified Channel Islands data centres.

name: JT Rue Des Pres Data Centre
notes: Official JT product description identifies the Rue Des Pres facility as a Tier 3 data centre with dual 1.5 MVA transformers, 4x550 kVA generators, 2x800 kVA UPS units, 840 kW cooling and managed hosting/colocation service. AP Technical's 2010 article said JT secured the Rue des Pres site as its fourth Jersey data centre, and Saradan describes the conversion into a 400-rack Tier 3 co-hosting data centre.

name: JT Central DC
notes: DatacenterMap lists JT Central DC at Telephone House, Minden Place, St Helier, describing Central Data Centre as one of four Tier 3 data centres in Jersey wholly owned by JT. JT's current business site confirms it provides secure Tier 3 data centre services from primary sites in Jersey and Guernsey, but the public JT page does not name Central DC or disclose MW capacity.

name: JT East DC
notes: DatacenterMap lists JT East DC at La Rue des Fonds, Grouville, and describes East Data Centre as one of four Tier 3 Jersey data centres wholly owned by JT with secure colocation, 24/7 security and resilient fibre connectivity. JT's current business site confirms Jersey Tier 3 data centre services, but no public MW capacity was found.

name: Sure Jersey Data Centre
notes: Sure's official Jersey Data Centre page advertises Tier III colocation in Jersey with individual halls/cages/shared space, inter-island connectivity, remote hands and 500 kW IT load. DatacenterMap corroborates the St Helier/Queens Road location and Tier 3 listing.
